University of Arizona, Water-energy tradeoffs in data centers: a case study in hot-arid climates (Phoenix colocation sites): air-cooled site had ~13% higher PUE but 66% lower source WUE than the evaporative site. https://experts.arizona.edu/en/publications/water-energy-tradeoffs-in-data-centers-a-case-study-in-hot-arid-c/

Equinix, What is Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE): air-cooled-only sites near 0 L/kWh, fully evaporative sites up to about 2.5 L/kWh. https://blog.equinix.com/blog/2024/11/13/what-is-water-usage-effectiveness-wue-in-data-centers/
The Green Grid, WUE: a green grid data center sustainability metric (WP #35, 2011): WUE = annual site water (L) / IT equipment energy (kWh).
